gemini.rationale: The customer-facing assets (California oil and gas operations) and the operational processes (drilling and production activity) transferred together, resulting in no gap_45. However, centrally located corporate functions (IT, HR, finance, etc.) did not transfer intact, creating a structural mismatch between the operations and the organizational support (gap_56 = 1). This gap was mitigated at closing by a Transition Services Agreement.

grok.rationale: gap_45 is 0 because the slice states the customer-facing California E&P asset separated together with the operational processes that produce and deliver it (CRC’s own drilling and production activity, ~26 rigs). gap_56 is 0 because the same closing structure states the people and management that run those operations crossed as well (Occidental-sourced CRC leadership team and ~1,600 California employees). Shared central corporate functions that did not move intact were bridged by a Transition Services Agreement, but that is not a product-vs-process or process-vs-organization mismatch in what transferred.

openai.rationale: The California exploration-and-production asset crossed together with CRC's drilling and production activity, including approximately 26 drilling rigs, so no product-to-process gap is documented at closing [SRC: SEC accession 0001047469-14-007128, Form 10-12B EX-99.1]. The CRC leadership team and approximately 1,600 California employees also accompanied the operations, so no process-to-organization gap is documented, although centrally provided corporate functions did not transfer intact [SRC: SEC accession 0001047469-14-007128, Form 10-12B EX-99.1].
